rows.message: no code that runs selects ORDER_SHIPPED on shop:*:orders: 2 consumers choose other types (handleFeed, handleLive)

message-type-unselected.why: handleFeed chooses ALERT_RAISED, and 1 subscription(s) behind GET /shops/:param/feed name a channel not read

type-never-published.why: 1 subscription(s) behind GET /shops/:param/feed name a channel not read

config-not-set.why: no deployment file of back-office was read: its settings may be set where the reading does not look

field-never-sent.why: `attempt` is compared under a type said two ways (BuildBot.handleBuildRetry: its parameter's type says BUILD_RETRIED; the code that calls it does so for BUILD_FAILED)

answer-field-never-returned.why: 1: what GET /categories/tree answers is not a shape read, so the fields its clients read were not compared; 2: `changesFromPrevious` is read behind a check that it is there (changeSummary, line 27): the client handles its absence
